title: Enforce PRD reference membership and complete V1 release traceability
goal: Make release completion provable from real PRD requirements instead of syntactically valid or incomplete references.
in_scope: Parse the approved PRD's real requirement IDs in validate.mjs
Reject dangling epic and story prd_ref values even when their REQ-xx format is valid
Reject a release contract when a PRD requirement tagged for that release has no matching backlog reference
Keep E-2 references complete for REQ-08 through REQ-16
out_of_scope: Renumbering or rewriting shipped REQ-01 through REQ-07
Changing requirement release tags without explicit product approval
acceptance: validate.mjs rejects epic or story prd_ref values that do not exist in the approved PRD, and rejects a release when any PRD requirement tagged for that release is absent from its backlog contract; every REQ-08 through REQ-16 requirement is referenced by E-2 and at least one E-2 story so V1 rollups cannot report completion while core capabilities are unevaluated.
invariants: The PRD remains the source of truth for requirement identity and release classification
A release cannot become complete through invented or dangling requirement IDs
